Container.Name: subtitlarr
Container.Overview:
Fills gaps in your Bazarr subtitle library by translating subtitles you already have (e.g. English) into languages you're missing (e.g. Spanish), using a local or cloud LLM. Never mounts your media folders — all reading and writing of subtitles happens through Bazarr's own REST API, so Bazarr remains the only thing with filesystem access to your library.
Requires a running Bazarr instance (with its API key) and at least one translation engine: Ollama (local, e.g. an existing Ollama container on this server), Gemini, or NVIDIA NIM (both cloud, free tiers available).
No media path needs to be mapped into this container — only the /data path below, which is Subtitlarr's own small SQLite database, not your library.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Subtitlarr web UI listens on inside the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Subtitlarr's own SQLite database (queue, run history, settings). NOT a media path — do not point this at your library.

Config.Name: Bazarr Base URL
Config.Description: Bazarr's root URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:6767 (or the container name/IP if on the same custom Docker network).

Config.Name: Bazarr API Key
Config.Description: Bazarr → Settings → General → API key.

Config.Name: Active Engine
Config.Description: Which translation engine to use: ollama, gemini, or nvidia.

Config.Name: Fallback Engine
Config.Description: Optional — same values as above, used automatically if the active engine fails or is rate-limited.

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: URL of an existing Ollama server/container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434.

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: Model name — must already be pulled on the target Ollama server (ollama pull gemma3:4b).

Config.Name: Ollama Context Window
Config.Description: Context window size in tokens — raise if long subtitle files come back incomplete (Ollama's own default of 4096 silently truncates larger prompts).

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional — free tier available at aistudio.google.com.

Config.Name: Gemini Model
Config.Description: Verify current at aistudio.google.com — Google periodically retires older model IDs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA API Key
Config.Description: Optional — free tier at build.nvidia.com.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Model
Config.Description: Must be a real instructable chat model, not a dedicated translation model (e.g. NOT Riva Translate).

Config.Name: Schedule Cron
Config.Description: 5-field cron expression for the main scheduled translation job.

Config.Name: Age Threshold (days)
Config.Description: Days a subtitle must be missing before a scheduled run will translate it — gives Bazarr's own providers first chance to find a real subtitle.

Config.Name: Daily Translation Limit
Config.Description: Max items translated per day by scheduled/full runs (0 = unlimited). Per-item re-runs always bypass this.

Config.Name: Pause Between Items (seconds)
Config.Description: Brief rest between translations so the GPU isn't pegged non-stop for hours (0 = no pause).

Config.Name: Queue Uploads
Config.Description: If true, translated subtitles are held locally instead of uploaded immediately — push them all in one batch later from the Jobs page (useful if uploads wake a sleeping NAS).

Config.Name: Sync Wanted/Missing Cron
Config.Description: Optional cron expression to auto-refresh Bazarr's wanted list. Leave blank for manual-only (triggered from the Jobs page).

Config.Name: Pull Pending Subtitles Cron
Config.Description: Optional cron expression to auto pre-fetch source subtitle content into the local cache. Leave blank for manual-only.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
